text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her training, Special Week,
looking
flustered, approaches me about
something.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The others in my class have been getting
better
and better lately.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose to them! So I wanna train a
little more
today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'm gonna do my best to
produce some
good results!
choice_data_list: わかった！気が済むまで走り込もう！
落ち着いて、オーバーワークになっちゃうよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue our training until the very
last
minute.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-you were right... I think I got a little
too worked
up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I need to cool myself down. Deep breaths... Phew... Fwaaah

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week appears to have calmed
down, but I
still have to do something
about her
overzealousness...
